def test(page):
    # Shared chrome precondition
    page.get_by_role("button", name="Switch profile, Alex").to_be_visible(precondition=True)
    page.get_by_role("button", name="Search library").to_be_visible(precondition=True)

    # Open Settings via the header gear icon
    page.click(1158, 40)
    page.get_by_role("button", name="Accessibility").click()
    page.get_by_role("heading", name="Accessibility").to_be_visible(precondition=True)
    page.get_by_role("button", name="Caption size Medium").to_be_visible(precondition=True)

    # Choose Large caption size
    page.get_by_role("button", name="Caption size Medium").click()
    page.get_by_role("dialog", name="Caption size").to_be_visible(precondition=True)
    page.get_by_role("button", name="Large").click()

    # Behavioral checks
    page.get_by_role("button", name="Caption size Large").to_be_visible()
    page.get_by_text("Large captions").to_be_visible()
    # Caption preview text rendered at the Large reading size
    page.expect_image(
        "large_preview",
        region=[970, 200, 1215, 340],
        threshold=0.1,
        max_diff_pixels=150,
    )

def test(page):
    # Shared chrome precondition
    page.get_by_role("button", name="Switch profile, Alex").to_be_visible(precondition=True)
    page.get_by_role("button", name="Search library").to_be_visible(precondition=True)

    # Open Settings via the header gear icon
    page.click(1158, 40)
    page.get_by_role("button", name="Accessibility").click()
    page.get_by_role("heading", name="Accessibility").to_be_visible(precondition=True)
    page.get_by_role("button", name="Caption size Medium").to_be_visible(precondition=True)

    # Choose Large caption size
    page.get_by_role("button", name="Caption size Medium").click()
    page.get_by_role("dialog", name="Caption size").to_be_visible(precondition=True)
    page.get_by_role("button", name="Large").click()

    # Behavioral checks
    page.get_by_role("button", name="Caption size Large").to_be_visible()
    # Caption preview text rendered at the Large reading size
    page.expect_image(
        "large_preview",
        region=[970, 200, 1215, 340],
        threshold=0.1,
        max_diff_pixels=150,
    )

I saved the test to `/workspace/output/test.py`. I haven't run it: there was no way to execute it while writing, so it has not been checked against either app state.

The test does these steps in order:

1. **Starting check:** confirms the header's "Switch profile, Alex" and "Search library" buttons are visible.
2. **Open settings:** clicks the header gear icon at (1158, 40), then opens Accessibility. It confirms the Accessibility heading and "Caption size Medium" are showing.
3. **Choose Large:** opens Caption size, confirms the "Caption size" dialog appears, and clicks Large.
4. **Check the result:**
   - The setting button must now read "Caption size Large".
   - A screenshot comparison checks the subtitle preview against a reference image called `large_preview`, which I captured after selecting Large. The compared area is pixels [970, 200, 1215, 340], with up to 150 differing pixels allowed. At Large, "A world worth exploring." in that preview is clearly bigger than at Medium, so the comparison should fail if the label changes but the preview stays the same size.

The preview area looked identical in two screenshots taken one after the other, so the comparison shouldn't be flaky. I also took a reference of the Medium preview, `medium_preview`, but the test doesn't use it.

I took out a text check for the "Large captions" label under the preview. The accessibility tree showed it merged with "Text appearance preview", so an exact text match might not have found it.
